description:
Cast Omni-Changeling by paying {2}{U}{U} due to Morophon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Honest Rutstein.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Omni-Changeling triggers, returning Honest Rutstein from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Honest Rutstein by paying {0} due to Morophon and Omni-Changeling.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Honest Rutstein triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.
